name: Chicken Pesto Cauliflower Casserole
method: oven bake (roast cauliflower, fold with chicken + pesto cream, top with cheese, bake)
why: Shredded chicken + roasted cauliflower bound in pesto-cream and mozzarella, no rice/pasta/potato. Published 563 cal / 41.7g protein / 11.8g total carbs is squarely mid-band with a strong protein-to-cal ratio. Every ingredient maps to the board (pesto is a tracked commodity). Distinct from the run's already-accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (pesto vs ranch/bacon). src_carbs is TOTAL carbs (net 7.1g).
